anchors.cell_block_centre: origin on the centre of the cell block at floor level (rooms, floors, ceilings)
anchors.cell_centre: origin on one cell's centre at floor level (corridors, stairs, pits, cave corners)
anchors.cell_edge: origin on a cell boundary line at floor level; the piece stands toward its front (+Z)
anchors.corner: origin on an inner corner line at floor level, facing the room diagonal
anchors.door_anchor: origin on the room.gd door anchor: 0.4 m in from the room edge = 0.1 m behind the boundary
anchors.free: footprint-centred free prop (any position on the floor)
anchors.wall_face: origin on a wall's inner face at floor level (sconces, banners, reliefs)

connectors.rule: facing sockets on the same cell edge; width 3.0 m
a door socket takes exactly one dgn.doorway frame (room.gd places it from the room's door data via the arch.door binding); dgn.door_locked / tmpl.boss_door may add an insert
sconce origin on the socket, facing the socket direction
bridge deck centred over a full pit cell, running north-south
water tile at the water level (WATER_Z) under the shore slope
cave walls meet end to end on cell boundaries

grid.note: room plot = cells x 4 m + 0.5 m apron each side; door.position for side cell i = 4*i + 2
